label: prop:x5-bring-weight-identification
title: $\mathbb{Z}_5$-weight identification: $x$ on $\mathcal{X}_5$ matches $w_1$ on Bring
html:
Let \sigma denote the cyclic generator of \mathbb{Z}_5. We write its induced action on regular functions on the left. On Bring's surface, the first Lagrange resolvent w_1 is an eigenvector of \sigma with eigenvalue \zeta_5^{-1} (prop:lagrange-resolvent-transform). On \mathcal{X}_5, the coordinate x is an eigenvector of \sigma with the same eigenvalue (prop:x5-z5-automorphism). Consequently, there is a canonical \mathbb{Z}_5-equivariant identification

  \mathcal{O}(\mathcal{X}_5)_{\zeta_5^{-1}}
   \overset{\sim}{\longrightarrow}
   \mathcal{O}(\mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{Br}})_{\zeta_5^{-1}},
  \qquad
  x  \longmapsto  w_1,

of the weight-(-1) isotypical components of the coordinate rings. This identification extends to a \mathbb{Z}_5-equivariant map of graded rings on the entire \mathbb{Z}_5-isotypical decomposition by sending x^{k} \mapsto w_1^{\,k} for 0 \leq k \leq 4 (with x^5 and w_1^{\,5} both invariant).
